title: UPS and Generator Architecture
summary: Interpret the conceptual transition from utility power to backup support.
objectives: Explain UPS continuity and generator roles.

vocab.def: A system that provides temporary power support during a transition.
A backup source that can support loads after a transition when available.
A change from one power source or state to another.

sections.heading: Sequence, do not service
sections.body: A model sequence is utility lost -> UPS carries load -> generator starts -> generator stabilizes -> load supported. Students interpret timestamps; they do not start or service generators.

practice.prompt: The UPS is supporting load but generator status is unknown. What is safe?
practice.answer: Record the status and escalate according to the scenario; do not operate generator controls.

quiz.question: What is the UPS role in this model?

reflectionPrompt: Which status would you verify before declaring the transition complete?
